object_description: compact low base with a light upper wood-and-glass structure
design_condition: Aligned with the existing building, the compact volume places a public reception space between the new building and canal while integrating the outdoor uses into the existing bathing complex.

positive.statement: The calm volumetric structure responds cleverly to the topographically demanding situation.

position.rationale: The compact two-level mass and low roof profile are clearly visible across all views.

positive.statement: The proposal creates strong spatial and visual relationships across horizontal, vertical, and diagonal connections.

position.rationale: Connections are inferred within the layered compact volume and its central opening.

positive.statement: The indoor and outdoor pools complement each other through a strong spatial relationship between inside and outside.

position.rationale: Pool relationships are internal and not distinctly sampled; the marker uses the lower east-side zone.

positive.statement: The visibility of the swimming pool is suitable for competitions and provides enough spectator space despite the compactness.

position.rationale: The competition pool and seating are not individually visible, so the main lower volume is used.

positive.statement: The outdoor facilities are high quality, skilfully integrated, and convincingly arranged.

position.rationale: Outdoor uses are approximated along the open ground-side edge beside the compact building.

positive.statement: The ecological construction, efficient support system, and affordable expected building costs are welcomed.

position.rationale: Construction performance is not directly visible; the marker references the lightweight upper structure.

negative.statement: The lack of a hairdressing area on the ground floor is not user-friendly.

position.rationale: The missing room is internal; the marker uses a plausible ground-floor zone near the public side.

negative.statement: Organizing the cloakrooms on two floors is cumbersome for users and makes orientation a challenge.

position.rationale: Cloakroom organization is internal and anchored to the stacked central building zone.

negative.statement: The location of the cloakrooms is unsuitable for using the outdoor pool.

position.rationale: The outdoor-pool relationship is not distinguishable; the marker uses the lower edge zone.

negative.statement: The separation of the kitchen and storage room on two floors is operationally problematic.

position.rationale: Service rooms are internal and placed in a plausible stacked zone within the compact volume.

negative.statement: The available space for right-of-way and parking appears tight.

position.rationale: The site-access criticism is anchored to the narrow open perimeter beside the building.

negative.statement: The concept is ultimately judged unsustainable because of the organization of the cloakrooms on two floors.

position.rationale: The judgment links sustainability to internal cloakroom organization within the stacked building volume.
